title: CourseAsCode Choice Activity
description: Schema for CHO_*.yaml Choice activity files

Type.description: Activity type identifier — must be CHOICE (case-insensitive)

Description.description: Short description shown on the course page

ShowResults.description: Whether and when to show results to students

AllowUpdate.description: Allow students to change their choice

AllowMultiple.description: Allow more than one option to be selected

ShowUnanswered.description: Show a column for users who have not answered

LimitAnswers.description: Limit the number of responses allowed per option (uses MaxAnswers)

CompletionSubmit.description: Mark complete when the student makes a choice

ShowPreview.description: Allow a preview before the choice opens

ShowAvailable.description: Show the number of remaining responses per option

Text.description: The option label shown to students

MaxAnswers.description: Max responses for this option when LimitAnswers is true (0 = unlimited)
